high.title: Banks Surprising Method of 'Keeping Money'
high.summary: Vietnamese banks are increasingly using stock dividends to retain capital for growth rather than paying out cash. TPBank approved a 20% total dividend plan, with only 5% in cash and 15% in stock, issuing over 416 million shares to increase charter capital by up to VND 4.161 trillion. MSB similarly approved a 20% stock bonus issue. This trend reflects banks prioritizing capital adequacy ratios and funding expansion over immediate cash returns to shareholders. The strategy is particularly relevant as banks prepare for credit growth targets and Basel II compliance requirements. Investors should monitor how this affects bank valuations and return on equity metrics.

high.title: Banks to Establish New Financial Institutions
high.summary: Vietcombank gained shareholder approval to establish a 100%-owned commercial bank at Vietnam's International Financial Center (IFC) with initial charter capital of VND 3 trillion. The subsidiary will provide specialized financial services to IFC members including payment services, international finance, asset management, and digital asset investments. Similarly, LPBank announced plans for an IFC subsidiary focused on international financial services, asset management, and digital asset management. These moves signal Vietnamese banks' strategic expansion into offshore financial services and preparation for Vietnam's evolving fintech landscape, potentially creating new revenue streams outside traditional domestic banking.

high.title: Bank Q1 2026 Results Update: Strong Profit Growth
high.summary: Vietnamese banks reported strong Q1 2026 results with VietinBank leading with approximately 56% pre-tax profit growth versus Q1 2025, potentially exceeding VND 10 trillion. BIDV recorded 2.6% credit growth and 15% year-on-year increase. The banking sector shows robust fundamentals with controlled NPL ratios and steady deposit growth despite challenging market conditions. This performance supports positive outlook for bank stocks and suggests healthy net interest margins. Foreign investors should note the sector's resilience and growth trajectory, particularly for major state-owned banks like VietinBank and BIDV which could see continued outperformance.

medium.title: Dividend Schedule Week 27/4-1/5: Cash Dividend Up to 90%, One Bank Distributes Over VND 3,000 Billion
medium.summary: VIB will pay 9% cash dividend on April 29, totaling VND 3.063 trillion to shareholders. The bank also approved capital increase plans from VND 34.040 trillion to VND 37.354 trillion. This significant cash outflow and capital expansion plan reflects strong financial position and growth ambitions.

medium.title: Multiple Gold Shops in Ho Chi Minh City Fined and Gold Confiscated
medium.summary: Market surveillance authorities in HCMC intensified inspections of gold trading establishments, resulting in fines and confiscation for businesses trading gold without proper documentation. This enforcement reflects authorities' efforts to maintain market stability amid volatile international gold prices.

medium.title: TCBS Chairman: Ready to Deploy Tokenized Assets Immediately After Receiving License
medium.summary: TCBS Chairman Nguyen Xuan Minh revealed the securities company is among few selected by regulators for digital asset consideration. TCBS has prepared infrastructure for tokenizing real assets and plans immediate deployment once regulatory framework is established, positioning for Vietnam's emerging digital asset market.

medium.title: TCBS AGM: Record Pre-tax Profit Target of VND 7,500 Billion, 20% Stock Dividend
medium.summary: TCBS set ambitious 2026 pre-tax profit target of VND 7.5 trillion and approved 20% stock dividend. The securities firm expects to benefit from Vietnam's market upgrade to emerging market status in September 2026, positioning for continued growth in brokerage and investment banking services.

medium.title: Techcombank AGM: Two Profit Scenarios, 7% Cash Dividend, Stock Bonus Up to 60%
medium.summary: Techcombank reported record 2025 pre-tax profit of VND 32.538 trillion, up 18.16% year-on-year. The bank maintains market-leading CASA ratio of 40.4% and achieved 645 trillion VND in assets under management. CEO emphasized the bank's evolution into a comprehensive financial ecosystem beyond traditional banking.
